terra.problem: “Jews Sent Out of Rome” mostly describes Paul meeting and working with Aquila and Priscilla in Corinth, not Rome. Reframe it around the order to leave Rome or omit it.
“Paul Longs to See Rome” happens before Paul reaches Rome; it describes his plan to visit, not an event in Rome.
“The Lord Sends Paul to Rome” takes place in Jerusalem, not Rome. The passage says Paul must testify in Rome, but does not describe him being sent there at that moment.
“Paul Writes to the Romans” describes a letter addressed to people in Rome, not an event taking place there. Paul says he has not yet been able to visit them.
Words such as “testify” and “saints” may need simpler wording or brief explanations for fifth-grade readers.
